cohort: 90 pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) requiring pharmacological management at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Metformin was found to be a safe and effective alternative to insulin for GDM management, associated with better postprandial glucose control and lower neonatal hypoglycemia, with comparable maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were 60.00% in the insulin group and 47.50% in the metformin group, though not statistically significant (p = 0.488).
